# Full Character Creation Studio v2.8.20 — Core v2.4.20

## Stage 0 — Standalone Krea2 baseline

Character Creator + Universal Shot Control remain a complete standalone generation path with an independent randomized seed. Chest anatomy is now resolved through one exclusive authority path. Stored bust controls remain available in the UI but are absent from every non-bust prompt and summary.

Stage 0 also includes:
- complete Crop Top + rigid Daisy Duke cutoff routing
- exposed Full Left/Right Leg Sleeve tattoo visibility below short hems
- Center Lip ring fixed to living lower-lip tissue while the nasal region remains unpierced
- Navel / Belly Button structured piercing location
- optional Scar / Mole / Beauty Mark descriptor box
- post-clothing strict rear camera lock for floor poses
- landmark-first Extended Puppy forward-arm geometry

## Stage 2 — Krea2 pre-LoRA documentation

Available base-shot plans:
1. `Identity Anchors — 3`
2. `Body-Only Regional Atlas — Clothed (102)`
3. `Body-Only Regional Atlas — Clinical Unclothed (102)`
4. `Complete Body-Only Regional Atlas — Clothed and Clinical (204)`
5. `Extreme Clinical Anatomy Close-Ups — Opt-In (resolved count)`
6. `Complete Pre-LoRA Documentation — Anchors + Body Atlas (207)`

Variations Per Shot multiplies the displayed base count. Body-only records exclude the complete face. Adult Nonbinary identity no longer blends chest/groin categories inside Stage 2; each regional item consumes the same canonical resolved anatomy used by Stage 0.

The opt-in extreme plan now produces true single-detail close-ups rather than broad torso/pelvis regional crops. It remains separate and is never automatically approved for identity-LoRA training.

## Stage 3 / Stage 4

Qwen remains at the retained 25-step test preset and manual review. Stage 4 remains the final Krea2 + identity-LoRA diversity lane and is intentionally unchanged until Stage 0 and Stage 2 pass live validation.
